markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Careful review
Flagged (tier 2) for invasive carcinoma [F1]; confirm invasion before releasing drafted ER, PR, HER2, Ki-67 orders.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| - | - | - |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 100%, InSitu 0%, Benign 0%, Normal 0% | Strong separation; ECE 5% (n=132) |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} (alpha 10%, 90% coverage) | Dataset guarantee, not case probability |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability; 68th OOD percentile [F6] | Typical input; no quality flag |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive (84%–89% similarity) [F5] | All nearest reference cases match |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 1, 3, 8) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score (+1.35 contribution; 19/20 AI spot check) [F2] · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 1, 7, 9) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score (+0.91 contribution; 18/20 AI spot check) [F3] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 10) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (-1.10) favors invasion (+0.86; caption-inconsistent) [F4] · Weak
- **Nuclear size and variation** (regions 1, 4, 5) · context · Mean 74.2 µm², CV 0.65 (93rd percentile) [F7] [F8] · Measured
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 1, 2, 5) · ↑ invasive · Positive score (+0.43 contribution), but 0/20 AI spot check · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting 3 top-risk regions beat random deletion (+0.0114, 95% CI +0.0021 to +0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (+0.0008 vs random, 95% CI -0.0088 to +0.0064); ignore unreliable normal_lobules (0/20), mitoses (0/20), necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- In situ carcinoma mimics invasion (contrast InSitu case BACH_0155 has 74% similarity; duct_confined is weak, 12/20).
- Calibration and 90% conformal coverage rely on 132 test patches (24 patients; coverage CI 76%–98%).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 1, 3, 8**: Verify stromal invasion before releasing drafted ER, PR, HER2, Ki-67 orders.
2. **Regions 1, 4, 5, 7, 9**: Confirm nuclear enlargement and pleomorphism in top concept and HoVer-Net regions.
3. **Regions 0, 10**: Inspect duct boundaries and tubule formation to exclude in situ carcinoma.
